extmetadata.ImageDescription:
Arturo O’Farrill Quintet at Victoria Teater. The concert was part of Oslo Jazzfestival and took place on 14. August 2018 in Oslo.

Lineup:
Arturo O’Farrill (piano)
Adam O’Farrill (trumpet)
Zachary O’Farrill (drums)
Boris Koslov (double bass)
Chad Lefkowitz Brown (saxophone)
